3. Wire an entry file at `/output/test4.mjs`, then verify Node output against the executable for help, missing args, valid args, and invalid `--a` cases.

/bin/bash -lc "bash -lc '
run_case() {
  label=\""'$1"
  shift
  prefix="/tmp/test4_check_${label}_$$"
  /workspace/dataset/test4_executable "$@" >"${prefix}.expected.out" 2>"${prefix}.expected.err"
  expected_code=$?
  node /output/test4.mjs "$@" >"${prefix}.actual.out" 2>"${prefix}.actual.err"
  actual_code=$?
  cat "${prefix}.expected.out" "${prefix}.expected.err" | sed "s/test4_executable/test4.mjs/g" | sed -E "s/'"\\[PYI-[0-9]+:ERROR\\]/[PYI-PID:ERROR]/g\" > \""'${prefix}.expected.norm"
  cat "${prefix}.actual.out" "${prefix}.actual.err" | sed -E "s/'"\\[PYI-[0-9]+:ERROR\\]/[PYI-PID:ERROR]/g\" > \""'${prefix}.actual.norm"
  if [ "$expected_code" -eq "$actual_code" ] && cmp -s "${prefix}.expected.norm" "${prefix}.actual.norm"; then
    printf "%s: PASS'"\\n\" \""'$label"
  else
    printf "%s: FAIL'"\\n\" \""'$label"
    printf "expected exit=%s actual exit=%s'"\\n\" \""'$expected_code" "$actual_code"
    printf "expected file=%s'"\\n\" \""'${prefix}.expected.norm"
    printf "actual file=%s'"\\n\" \""'${prefix}.actual.norm"
  fi
}
run_case no_args

Created under `/output` with local-only ESM modules:

- [program_name.mjs](/output/lib/program_name.mjs:1)
- [argparse_like.mjs](/output/lib/argparse_like.mjs:1)
- [schedule_errors.mjs](/output/lib/schedule_errors.mjs:1)
- [schedule_like.mjs](/output/lib/schedule_like.mjs:1)
- [test4.mjs](/output/test4.mjs:1)

The implementation is pure `.mjs` ESM, uses no external packages, manually parses `process.argv`, and reproduces the probed behavior of the Python executable for `--help`, required `--a/--b/--c`, `--name=value`, repeated flags, unknown arguments, and the `schedule.every().monday.at(...)` success/error paths. The success output matches the executable’s printed job string exactly:

```text
Job(interval=1, unit=weeks, do=None, args=(), kwargs={})
```

Verification was run with `node /output/test4.mjs` against `/workspace/dataset/test4_executable` for these cases: no args, help, valid invocation, missing value, unknown arg after valid args, invalid time format, invalid hour, and `--a -1`.
